description: Reads a matched board (bookmaker back prices with exchange lay prices) for one sport at the bookmakers you name. Spends tokens: priced first, and refused when it would cost more than max_tokens.

bookmakers.description: Bookmaker keys from the bookmakers tool

exchanges.description: Exchange keys; left out, every exchange on the board

limit.description: Most events to return; a note counts the rest

markets.description: Market keys such as h2h; left out, every market on the board

max_tokens.description: Refuse the call when its quoted price is above this many tokens. Ask the user before raising it.

region.description: Region code. Left out, the API uses uk.

sport.description: Which sport: soccer, or a competition key from the sports tool such as soccer_epl

name: odds
title: Odds
